gazebo_source.launch_method: robot_state_publisher/Gazebo spawn through navigation or mapping launch
gazebo_source.format: sensor_msgs/msg/Image; passthrough depth encoding consumed by cv_bridge
gazebo_source.timestamp_behavior: Gazebo sensor timestamps; vision_node selects nearest buffered depth frame within 0.15 seconds

real_source.finding: No non-Gazebo publisher for /camera/depth/image_raw exists in the workspace. bridge_node publishes RGB and CameraInfo only.
real_source.impact: Real capture cannot persist an observation because vision_node requires a synchronized depth frame.
